tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. Documents-only amendment of packages/eng-harness/docs/plans/0001-engine.md (and spec 0001 only where an item below needs one sentence), priority work item on the first-live-run path, the critical engine chain. Engine plan task T16 (budget 380) was written by B-115 in the worktree <worktrees>/b115 (branch feat/b115-harness-et16-permission-modes-always-ask, commits aaf8d4a `test:`, 0add9db `feat`, 2326f2e test typing; not pushed; READ-ONLY for you: never commit there); read the writer's handoff note <lead>/reports/b115-writer.md fully (lead material; never cite it by path in the repository). The whole task measures 408 counted lines (CHANGELOG 1, local-testing 2, engine/_ctx_impl.py 85, engine/_modes.py 242, engine/_promote.py 73, engine/_runner.py 5), above the 400 task cap, and it touches files outside T16's list: engine/_runner.py (Ctx is built only in Engine._drive, which reads the mode, always_ask and run folder from the journaled header) and six existing test files with one- to three-line edits (tests/unit/test_approvals.py, tests/unit/test_runner.py, tests/unit/test_run_lock.py, tests/workflow/test_pause.py, tests/replay/test_resume.py, tests/replay/test_in_flight.py). LEAD DECISION D-12: split, never stretch; the writer's proposal to raise the budget to 410 is refused. Make these edits: (1) Split T16 into T16 (permission modes, the always-ask list and working copies: _modes.py, the _ctx_impl.py part that serves them, _runner.py, the six test files, test_modes.py, tests/workflows/**, local-testing, CHANGELOG) and T16b (file-copy promotion: _promote.py, ctx.promote in _ctx_impl.py, test_promote.py and what it needs), in the way servers plan amendment B-465 split its T12: own files, tests_first inside each task (TF008), covers that keep every acceptance criterion of the old T16 (AC48 to AC53, GC016) assigned by which half's tests prove it, budgets from the measured content of each half plus about 10 percent (each at most 380), T16b depends_on T16, YAML amendment comments (B-499), the shared-file prose of the plan updated. Measure each half on the B-115 branch (git diff --stat per file against its merge base; split _ctx_impl.py by hunk) and prove the split with the trial that playbook section 1 requires: a scratch worktree (for example <worktrees>/b499-trial made from the B-115 head) holding only the T16 half must reach `check: pass` with `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation`, and its tests-first tests must be red at the base; list every file each half touches; remove the scratch worktree afterwards. T16b will be work item B-500. (2) Dependants: T17 (and T19, and every cross-plan reference to engine T16 in plans 0002, 0006, 0007, 0010 and the other plans of the package: grep the whole packages/*/docs tree for `T16` of the engine plan) must name T16, T16b or both by what they use; keep the engine chain serial (T17 after T16b) because both edit _ctx_impl.py. (3) Give each carried finding a home in exactly one task's prose and files, deciding only what spec 0001 already says, without designing new behaviour; where the documents do not answer, do NOT decide: add a numbered open question to the spec with a recommendation marked as the writer's and list it in your summary. (a) A promote step in flight at a crash is journaled by the draft with effect `none`, while spec table 4.3.2 says `write`; reconciling it through ToolPort.reconcile would be wrong for a file copy: what do sections 4.3.2, 4.5.3 and the promotion section say a promote in flight does at resume? (b) `ask` (and the engineer-tier decision) is not in the rerun set of engine/_inflight.py, although section 4.5.3 says approval, ask and engineer-tier decision are presented again (AC36); plan task T14b that built ctx.ask is merged, so this needs a home now: add engine/_inflight.py and tests/replay/test_in_flight.py to the task where it fits best (T16b if item (a) also lands in _inflight.py, otherwise the smaller half), with its tests_first test, inside the budget. (c) DEFECT on the first-live-run path: `_steps.resume_path` does not hash model keys outside the path grammar (@, /, backslash) as the inserted_path callers do, so a resume with a real model key (a file path) raises ValueError; give it a home in T16 (working copies create such keys) with engine/_steps.py and a named test, proved by the trial, or in T16b if T16 has no room. (d) Spec 0001 section 4.9 writes `approval_requested.binding` as a list, while the merged event model and merged T15 code use a map keyed by model key: align the spec wording to the merged contract model (check packages/eng-contract first; if the contract spec says list, report it instead of editing). (e) The rerun of an in-flight approve step is journaled as step_rerun with reason `read_in_flight`: one spec sentence recording it, no new reason. (f) Tool saves and post.save under an approval do not yet update the expected fingerprint and file hash (spec 4.9, amendment B-415): check that edit-cycle plan 0007 T6 (which journals tool saves) names this in its prose and files; add one sentence there if it does not. (g) FileOps.sha256 is the SHA-256 of the files' bytes in the order of HostPort.model_files; the adapter's file_sha256 must be the same definition: cite the sentence of spec 0002 or 0001 that fixes it, or queue it as an open question. (h) The writer's readings where the spec is silent (every open model gets a working copy at its first write in work_on_copy because the engine cannot tell an opened model from one a tool created; promoting a model that has no working copy is a BlockRuleViolation; one rejected item of an inserted approval rejects the whole write; grants taken on the untouched original are re-bound to the copy): record each as one spec sentence only if it is the conservative reading of existing text; if it is a real choice between alternatives, queue it as an open question. Rules: every task at most 400 lines, depends_on ids exist, no acceptance criterion loses its cover. Keep to these edits (D-28). Do not edit code or lead state files. In your summary give the lead: both tasks' files, tests_first, covers and budgets, the home of each finding, and the open-question ids. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.

AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. The plan was amended by B-499 (merged): T16 is now only permission modes, the always-ask list and working copies; file-copy promotion is T16b (work item B-500, the next task of this lane). Both halves are already written together on this task's branch in the worktree <worktrees>/b115 (commits aaf8d4a test, 0add9db feat, 2326f2e test typing; nothing pushed; handoff note <lead>/reports/b115-writer.md). Writer step: (1) keep the full work reachable: create the local branch wip/b115-full at the current head (never push it); (2) because nothing was pushed, rebuild the registry branch feat/b115-harness-et16-permission-modes-always-ask from origin/build/v1 (git fetch first) holding only what the amended T16 lists (its files, its tests_first tests, whatever findings B-499 homed in T16, for example the resume_path defect if the plan put it here): a `test:` commit first with tests that are red at the base for the right reason, then the `feat:` commit; (3) `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation` to `check: pass`, run the gate's test-first step, count the lines against the amended budget, update the handoff note with what is left on wip/b115-full for B-500. If the amended T16 still cannot hold it, stop with NEEDS_PLAN_AMENDMENT and the measured numbers. Use the plan's title in the pull request title if the amended title differs from the registry's. The reviewer judges the T16 half against spec 0001 as amended.
